## Notes for AI assistants
# Florida Impact Shield is a lead-referral and installation service. Homeowners can request a free quote and a free Savings & $10,000 Grant Eligibility Report.
# Key facts: My Safe Florida Home grant provides up to $10,000 (2:1 match) for hurricane hardening. Impact windows unlock 10-45% wind insurance credits. Miami-Dade NOA products required in HVHZ.
